text: The hull creaks as the sub descends past 100 meters. Somewhere aft, a wrench clatters to the deck. The men hold their breath, listening for the next depth charge.
'I heard the British have a new sonar. They say it can hear a pin drop at a mile.'
April 12, 1943: Sighted convoy at dawn. Fog thick, sonar bearings uncertain. Ordered silent running. Crew tense but steady.
Some say a U-boat vanished near the Azores, never found. Only a garbled radio message: 'Strange lights below... hull vibrating.'
Battery at 40%. Oxygen scrubbers running hot. Recommend surfacing soon.
